schemes.description: Careers Service extracurricular programme: after an assessment task and training, mixed teams of 4-6 Oxford students (undergraduates to DPhils, any subject) work for about five days on a strategic challenge defined with a client organisation (businesses, charities, overseas firms), liaise directly with the client and present research and recommendations, usually as a PowerPoint presentation on a pre-booked online call. Runs (per the employer-facing page) three times a year.
schemes.eligible_faculties_programmes: All subjects; current students from 1st-year undergraduates to DPhils
schemes.eligibility_restrictions: Saïd Business School students, visiting students, research staff, alumni and previous participants excluded; application with assessment task (selection).
schemes.delivery_format: Remote/online team work with online client presentation
schemes.project_evidence: Defined strategic challenge outlined with the client; output is a presentation of research and recommendations [1][2][3].
schemes.group_evidence: Careers mixes applicants into teams of four to six, often mixing undergraduates and postgraduates [1][2].
schemes.employer_evidence: Client organisations work with Careers to define the challenge, teams liaise directly with them, and clients receive the final presentation of recommendations; clients get a licence to use the report [1][2][3].
schemes.partner_role: Sets challenge with Careers Service; briefing call, check-in, receives final presentation/report
schemes.named_partners: Olga's Fine Foods (Australian food manufacturer; ESG roadmap project, undated article); past clients described as a faith-based charity, a fundraising charity and an overseas business
schemes.deliverable: Client presentation of research and recommendations (PowerPoint)
schemes.unresolved: Conflicting status evidence: the programme page, skills roadmap and news navigation label TOSCA 'Programme Paused' ('This programme is paused at the moment'), while the employer Collaborative Projects page describes it as running three times a year and testimonials reference Michaelmas 2025. Classified 'Current status unclear' per round-2 ruling; weight of programme-specific evidence suggests a pause after Michaelmas 2025.

profile_md:
**Oxford** (partial review) shows qualifying provision in three places, but no institution-wide curricular route.

- **Careers Service (central, extracurricular, selective):** a family of team consultancy programmes for real clients. **The Oxford Strategy Challenge** runs 5-day projects for mixed teams of 4-6 students, from first-year undergraduates to DPhils in any subject (Saïd students excluded); clients define the challenge and receive the recommendations. **Making a Difference** serves charities and social enterprises (50 places a term). **The Student Consultancy** (4-6 weeks) and **The Agency** (term-long marketing briefs) are similar. Most of these pages are now labelled *Programme Paused*, although there are testimonials from Michaelmas 2025 and Hilary 2026, so their current status is unclear.
- **Embedded in degrees:**
  - **Computer Science:** the compulsory second-year **Group Design Practical** (HT2026). Teams of 5-6 build software for industrial sponsors such as G-Research and Palantir, who co-supervise.
  - **MSc Energy Systems:** the whole cohort works as a consultancy for an external stakeholder (2025/26 handbook), although some past stakeholders were internal.
  - **Saïd MBA:** the optional summer **Strategic Consulting Project** for companies and charities. The client provides sponsors and sits on the final presentation panel.
- **Near-misses:**
  - Engineering Science's compulsory 3YP group design project has only occasional company sponsors.
  - The MMSC case studies have no evidenced external client.
  - The legacy **Micro-Internship Programme** is an individual placement.
- **Uncertain:** humanities and social sciences, law and medicine were not searched because the search budget ran out, and it is not confirmed whether the Careers programmes will resume.
gaps: Arts/humanities/social sciences and 'other' areas not searched (budget). Careers Service programme status for 2026/27 (paused vs running) unresolved. GDP 2025/26 sponsor list; 3YP sponsored share; MBA SCP team counts; MaDe team structure and eligibility; TSC/Agency eligibility. Further departmental instances likely (e.g. Smith School MSc SEE, Blavatnik MPP, OII, Continuing Education).
